title: What Scripture Actually Says About Being Sidelined by an Injury (It's Not Wasted Time)
caption:
Torn shoulder. Rolled ankle. Six weeks off the bar, off the field, maybe off the job.

If losing the lifts made you feel like less of a man, the lifts were carrying more weight than they should.

Scripture has a lot to say about weak seasons. Elijah got fed and put to sleep before he got a new assignment. Paul begged for his thorn to go and heard no.

"My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness." 2 Corinthians 12:9

Do the rehab. Read a Gospel. Use the hours you got back.

Save this for the next time you're benched.
